title: Florabound Promise

outfit_card.silhouette: Fairy-tale A-line gown featuring a structured floral corset, tiered asymmetric gossamer overskirt with petal-cut edges, and detached billowing butterfly-wing sheer sleeves.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: An oversized gossamer organza bow veil paired with a delicate gold forehead chain set with dangling teardrop crystals and pearl tassels.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: A pastel green structured corset bodice adorned with 3D floral beadwork and vine embroidery, featuring a sheer illusion halter neck and detached, crystalline flared organza flutter sleeves.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A high-low ballgown skirt of multi-tiered mint and blush organza embroidered with botanical vine motifs and dimensional blossoms, paired with sheer crystal-dusted lace tights and strappy heeled sandals.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Entwined morning glory vines, dimensional crystal-dusted blossom appliqués, luminous dragonfly motifs, and trailing iridescent sheer ribbon streamers.
